title: You Think Memory Works Like a Camera, Yet One Word Made Witnesses See Fake Broken Glass
description:
You think your eyes record memories like a camera! Yet one swapped word planted fake broken glass! This is the true story of Elizabeth Loftus's Crash Experiment. Here is what went wrong with trusting eyewitness recall.
